menu_options.pair: Pair a new light with Home Assistant
menu_options.share: Import lights from the Lumineo app

share.title: Import from the Lumineo app
share.description: In the Lumineo app, open the share settings QR code and decode it (any QR scanner). Paste the resulting link (https://stringlight-setting-share...json) here, or paste the JSON file content. The app keeps working alongside Home Assistant.

pair.title: Pair with Home Assistant
pair.description: Pick an unpaired light. Lights already paired with the Lumineo app don't show up here: press their **Unpair** button in Home Assistant (after importing them), or factory-reset them, first. The light blinks briefly while it pairs.

pair_confirm.title: Pair with Home Assistant
pair_confirm.description: Pair the unpaired Bluetooth mesh light {address} with Home Assistant? It will no longer work with the Lumineo app.

progress.pairing: Pairing the light. This takes 10 to 30 seconds.

error.invalid_share: That doesn't look like a Lumineo share (missing keys or lights).
error.cannot_fetch: Could not download the share link.
error.no_devices: No unpaired lights found. Make sure the light is powered and near a Bluetooth proxy, and that it's not paired with the Lumineo app (unpair or factory-reset it first). Submit to search again.

abort.already_configured: This mesh is already configured (settings were updated).
abort.light_added: {name} was added to your Home Assistant mesh.
abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth mesh device is not a Telink/Lumineo light.
abort.already_paired: This light is already paired with Home Assistant.
